attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as a NAT gateway on its private-network interface (eth1, 10.50.50.254/24) with a source-NAT masquerade rule out eth0 and a default-drop forward filter allowing established/related and eth1-originated traffic. Gave node2 and node3 static addresses on their matching private NIC (enp8s0: 10.50.50.11/24 and 10.50.50.12/24) with a default route via node1, via systemd-networkd drop-in files. Verified via conntrack on node1 that traffic from both nodes is masqueraded to node1's WAN address (10.100.232.10) and reaches the internet (curl bound to the private interface returns 200-series/redirect responses). Then executed the mandatory sequential single-node-restart protocol on node1, node2, and node3 — captured pre-restart boot_id and health, issued a background-acknowledged `reboot`, polled until exec returned, confirmed each node's boot_id changed, and re-verified NAT config/connectivity (or private-interface config/connectivity) after each restart before moving to the next node.
